### 写入策略

```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE dws_shop_l2cat_potential_buyer__reg_s0_live
  PARTITION (grass_region, grass_date)
SELECT
  user_id,
  shop_l2 AS l2_shop_cat,
  CASE WHEN (ppv >= 9 OR atc >= 5 OR orders >= 1) THEN 3
       WHEN (ppv >= 6 OR atc >= 3 OR orders >= 1) THEN 2
       WHEN (ppv >= 3 OR atc >= 1 OR orders >= 1) THEN 1
       ELSE 0 END AS potential_buyer_type,
  upper('${region}') AS grass_region,
  date'${yesterday}' AS grass_date
FROM shop_joined_base;
```
